title: Dead End City — gameplay and graphics review
introduction: Native game screenshots from the first-four-mission review. Fresh gameplay and staged inspection scenes are identified individually. The gallery retains all earlier vehicle, motorcycle and physics reviews.

screenshots.title: Opening call and readable dialogue
screenshots.description: Fresh public opening: the phone call is accepted with E and Enter. High graphics; the subtitle clears the mission card and minimap.

screenshots.title: High Ground: digging at the summit
screenshots.description: A staged summit inspection followed by the normal held-E action. The digging prompt stays clear of terrain status and dialogue. High graphics.

screenshots.title: Recover the package from a stranded vehicle
screenshots.description: The rear retrieval prompt appears after normal digging and loading in a staged vehicle fixture. The package can return to the player’s backpack. High graphics.

screenshots.title: Fort Sentinel records office in rain
screenshots.description: A staged view after the full ID inspection, with the normal records-entry prompt. High graphics at night in rain; the objective banner is the game’s normal briefing.

screenshots.title: A Seat at the Table: Blue Hour at dusk
screenshots.description: Staged inspection of the second mission’s terrace, guests and city environment. High graphics. This image is separate from the recorded ordinary mission win.

screenshots.title: Borrowed Stripes: the CIRRUS meeting
screenshots.description: Staged inspection of the fourth mission’s seated meeting with Anton Varga. High graphics. The ordinary objective-to-completion run is retained separately in the audit.

screenshots.title: The recovered package stays with you
screenshots.description: Final packaged build, High graphics: the fitted backpack remains visible on foot. Staged inspection camera after normal held-E digging, with the dialogue allowed to expire.

screenshots.title: Chase dialogue and checkpoint labels
screenshots.description: Final packaged build, High graphics: chase dialogue clears the lower HUD and the full Fort Sentinel name stays clear of navigation. Staged uniform/checkpoint inspection.

screenshots.title: Dockside Favor completed with ordinary controls
screenshots.description: Raw gameplay evidence from the successful first-mission run: pursued cargo delivery, sealed warehouse and back-door exit. Low graphics; 100 HP and wanted level zero. Failed attempts are retained separately.
